blocks.zh: 充填系統功能性（續）：機器人整合、連續批次、換型與速度
blocks.en: Filling System Functionality (continued): Robotics Integration, Continuous Batches, Changeover and Speed

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解連續充填 (Continuous Filling) 與批次充填 (Batch Filling) 的定義差異，以及隔離器 (Isolator) 在延長生產中的核心角色。
blocks.en: Understand the difference between continuous filling and batch filling, and the central role of the isolator in extended production.

blocks.zh: 掌握活動填充 (Campaign Filling) 設計中無菌保證 (SA) 的關鍵挑戰，包含過濾器更換、RTP 導入與 APS 設計。
blocks.en: Grasp the key sterility assurance (SA) challenges in campaign filling design, including filter changes, RTP introduction and APS design.

blocks.zh: 了解換型功能性 (Changeover Functionality) 如何直接影響設備整體效率 (OEE) 與每單位成本，以及 SU 技術的侷限。
blocks.en: Understand how changeover functionality directly affects overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) and cost per unit, and the limits of single-use (SU) technology.

blocks.zh: 分析充填速度的決定因素——充填曲線 (Filling Curve)、IPC 模式選擇，以及高價值產品的保產功能如何與速度形成取捨。
blocks.en: Analyze what determines filling speed: the filling curve, the choice of IPC mode, and how product-conserving features trade off against speed for high-value products.

blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 機器人整合 (Robotics Integration): 在無菌充填中，機器人的首要任務是替代人工干預 (Human Intervention)，因為每一次人員進入 Grade A 環境都是污染風險。設計時需考量：CFD 氣流模擬確保機械臂動作不產生亂流；人機工程確保零件重量在機器人負載範圍內。
blocks.en: Robotics integration: In aseptic filling, the first job of a robot is to replace human intervention, because every entry of personnel into the grade A environment is a contamination risk. The design must consider: CFD airflow simulation to ensure that robot arm movements do not create turbulence; and ergonomics to ensure that component weights are within the robot's load capacity.

blocks.zh: PP 的機器人優勢：蠕動泵 (PP) 的流體路徑（矽膠軟管）是預組裝的封閉系統，機器人只需抓取預組裝的充填針組件置入 Grade A 即可。而 RPP、TP、DP 的流體路徑需要在無菌環境內進行複雜組裝，機器人難以執行這些精密連接動作。
blocks.en: Robotic advantage of the PP: The fluid path of a peristaltic pump (PP), a silicone tubing set, is a pre-assembled closed system, so the robot only needs to pick up the pre-assembled filling needle assembly and place it in grade A. The fluid paths of the RPP, TP and DP, by contrast, must be assembled in a complex way inside the aseptic environment, and a robot has difficulty performing such precise connections.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像在手術室讓機器人協助準備手術器具。PP 就像提供一套已滅菌的一次性外科包 (Surgical Pack)——機器人只要拿進去放好即可。RPP/TP/DP 則像要求機器人在手術室內現場組裝複雜的手術器械——精密度要求極高，失敗風險大。
blocks.en: Imagine a robot helping to prepare surgical instruments in an operating room. The PP is like supplying a sterilized, single-use surgical pack: the robot just carries it in and puts it in place. The RPP/TP/DP is like asking the robot to assemble complex surgical instruments on the spot in the operating room: the precision required is very high and the risk of failure is large.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: CIP/SIP 能力是一把雙刃劍：對 RPP、TP、DP 而言，CIP/SIP 可以省去每批次的流體路徑拆裝，但如果活動 (Campaign) 中途需要換泵，這個優勢就消失了。此時無 CIP/SIP 的 SU-PP 反而因可以快速無菌引入預組裝元件而佔優。
blocks.en: CIP/SIP capability is a double-edged sword: for the RPP, TP and DP, CIP/SIP removes the need to disassemble and reassemble the fluid path for every batch, but if the pump has to be changed in the middle of a campaign, this advantage disappears. In that case the SU-PP, which has no CIP/SIP, comes out ahead because pre-assembled components can be introduced aseptically and quickly.

blocks.zh: 決策原則：無菌保證 (SA) > 商業彈性。機器人設計不能只看「能否執行動作」，更要確認動作不會危害 Grade A 環境的氣流完整性。
blocks.en: Decision principle: sterility assurance (SA) > commercial flexibility. A robot design cannot look only at whether it "can perform the movement"; it must also confirm that the movement will not compromise the airflow integrity of the grade A environment.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若您的 CDMO 新線計劃引入充填機器人，您會優先選擇哪種泵型？理由為何？
blocks.en: If your CDMO's new line plans to introduce a filling robot, which pump type would you choose first, and why?

blocks.zh: 為何 CFD 建模在機器人設計階段如此重要？它可以預測什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why is CFD modeling so important at the robot design stage? What risks can it predict?

blocks.zh: 4.1 — Continuous Filling / Campaign Filling Versus Batch Filling (doc p82–p83) 4.1 — 連續充填／批次生產充填與批次充填之比較（文件第 82–83 頁）
blocks.en: 4.1 — Continuous Filling / Campaign Filling Versus Batch Filling (doc p82–p83)

blocks.zh: 三種生產模式的對比：
blocks.en: Comparison of the three production modes:

blocks.zh: 批次充填 (Batch Filling)：每批結束後完整換型，最靈活但停機時間最長。
blocks.en: Batch filling: A full changeover after each batch; the most flexible, but with the longest downtime.

blocks.zh: 連續充填 (Continuous Filling)：同一規格容器連續生產，批次定義改為體積或時間，幾乎無換型停機。
blocks.en: Continuous filling: Containers of the same format are produced continuously; the batch is defined by volume or time, and there is almost no changeover downtime.

blocks.zh: 活動充填 (Campaign Filling)：同一原料藥，不同容器規格依序充填，折衷方案——共享前置準備時間，但需在密閉狀態下換型。
blocks.en: Campaign filling: The same drug substance is filled into different container formats in sequence. It is a compromise: set-up time is shared, but changeover must be done in a closed state.

blocks.zh: 活動充填的核心挑戰：如何在不開門的前提下，將下一批所需的格式零件 (Format Parts) 預先引入屏障內。
blocks.en: The core challenge of campaign filling: how to introduce the format parts needed for the next batch into the barrier in advance, without opening the door.

blocks.zh: 想像 F1 賽車維修站 (Pit Stop)：
blocks.en: Think of a Formula 1 pit stop:

blocks.zh: 連續充填 = 同一輛賽車連續跑多圈，中途只加油、不換輪胎——最省時間。
blocks.en: Continuous filling = the same car runs many laps in a row, refueling but not changing tires along the way: the greatest time saving.

blocks.zh: 活動充填 = 同一台發動機，依序裝進兩台不同車身——事前要把第二台車身的備件全塞進維修站，才不用中途開站門取件。
blocks.en: Campaign filling = the same engine fitted in sequence into two different car bodies: the spare parts for the second body must all be stocked in the pit beforehand, so that nobody has to open the pit door mid-race to fetch them.

blocks.zh: 批次充填 = 每場比賽後完整拆卸重組——靈活但費時最長。
blocks.en: Batch filling = a complete teardown and rebuild after every race: flexible but the most time-consuming.

blocks.zh: 隔離器的「密閉門」就是維修站的玻璃圍欄——一旦打開，無菌屏障的完整性即受威脅。
blocks.en: The isolator's "closed door" is the glass partition of the pit: once it is opened, the integrity of the sterile barrier is at risk.

blocks.zh: SA 決策核心：連續/活動模式的關鍵不是「效率有多高」，而是「能否在不破壞屏障的前提下完成換型」。
blocks.en: The core of the SA decision: The key to continuous/campaign mode is not "how efficient it is" but "whether changeover can be completed without breaching the barrier".

blocks.zh: Annex 1 過濾器限制：除非有驗證數據，液體除菌過濾器使用時間不得超過一個工作日。這對多天期連續批次是重大限制——必須在設計階段規劃平行過濾路徑 (Parallel Filtration Pathways) 或預消毒的一次性系統 (Pre-sterilized SUS)。
blocks.en: Annex 1 filter limit: Unless validated, a liquid sterilizing filter must not be used for longer than one working day. This is a major constraint for multi-day continuous batches: parallel filtration pathways or pre-sterilized single-use systems (SUS) must be planned at the design stage.

blocks.zh: APS 設計注意：無菌製程模擬 (APS) 必須納入連續生產期間的換型干預，但 APS 本身不能用來「驗證」或「決定」最大生產持續時間——這必須由製程本身的能力與驗證數據決定。
blocks.en: APS design note: The aseptic process simulation (APS) must include the changeover interventions that occur during continuous production, but the APS itself cannot be used to "validate" or "determine" the maximum production duration; that must be decided by the capability of the process itself and by validation data.

blocks.zh: 效益計算思維 Benefit Calculation
blocks.en: Benefit Calculation

blocks.zh:
假設每次換批停機成本：
  隔離器氫氧化氫去污 (HPV): 4 小時
  完整性測試 + 手套測試: 2 小時
  設備清洗/設定: 4 小時
  合計: ~10 小時/次換批

活動生產（5批/活動）vs 批次生產（5批獨立）：
  節省停機時間 = 10小時 × (5-1) = 40小時

若產能為 3,000 vials/小時：
  節省產量潛力 = 40小時 × 3,000 = 120,000 vials
blocks.en:
Assume the downtime cost of each batch changeover is:
  Isolator vaporized hydrogen peroxide (HPV) decontamination: 4 hours
  Integrity test + glove test: 2 hours
  Equipment cleaning/set-up: 4 hours
  Total: ~10 hours per batch changeover

Campaign production (5 batches per campaign) vs batch production (5 independent batches):
  Downtime saved = 10 hours × (5-1) = 40 hours

If capacity is 3,000 vials/hour:
  Potential output saved = 40 hours × 3,000 = 120,000 vials

blocks.zh: 若客戶計劃將 500L 同一原料藥分裝成 2mL 和 10mL 兩種規格，您會建議批次充填還是活動充填？評估哪些因素？
blocks.en: If a customer plans to split 500 L of the same drug substance into two formats, 2 mL and 10 mL, would you recommend batch filling or campaign filling? What factors would you evaluate?

blocks.zh: 為什麼隔離器比 RABS 更適合連續/活動生產？從 SA 決策層級分析。
blocks.en: Why is an isolator better suited than RABS to continuous/campaign production? Analyze from the SA decision hierarchy.

blocks.zh: 4.1.4 (cont.) — Equipment Design for Campaign Flexibility (doc p84) 4.1.4 (cont.) — 批次生產彈性之設備設計（文件第 84 頁）
blocks.en: 4.1.4 (cont.) — Equipment Design for Campaign Flexibility (doc p84)

blocks.zh: Universal Transport Technologies（通用傳輸技術）的三種形式：
blocks.en: Three forms of universal transport technology:

blocks.zh: Universal/Adjustable Rake（通用耙式）: 傳輸爪可調整間距，適應不同容器直徑。
blocks.en: Universal/Adjustable Rake: The spacing of the transport fingers can be adjusted to suit different container diameters.

blocks.zh: Walking-Beam System（步進梁系統）: 容器在梁上步進移動，可透過配方調整節距。
blocks.en: Walking-Beam System: Containers move step by step on the beam, and the pitch can be adjusted through the recipe.

blocks.zh: Prismatic Carrier Pockets（三角形載具）: 三角形凹槽設計，不同直徑的容器自然定位於凹槽不同深度，實現一套機構適應多尺寸。
blocks.en: Prismatic Carrier Pockets: A triangular pocket design in which containers of different diameters naturally locate at different depths in the pocket, so one mechanism fits multiple sizes.

blocks.zh: Universal Star Wheel（通用撥瓶輪）: 單一撥瓶輪包含多個不同直徑的凹槽，自動切換至目標尺寸。
blocks.en: Universal Star Wheel: A single star wheel contains several pockets of different diameters and switches automatically to the target size.

blocks.zh: 這些技術的共同目標：透過「食譜 (Recipe) 驅動的自動調整」替代「物理換型」，使換型可在密閉狀態下完成。
blocks.en: The common goal of these technologies: to replace "physical changeover" with "recipe-driven automatic adjustment", so that changeover can be completed in a closed state.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 各泵型的活動限制
blocks.en: Key Notes — Campaign Limitations of Each Pump Type

blocks.zh: RPP 的充填範圍限制：活塞行程決定充填體積。若活動中需要跨越活塞所能涵蓋的範圍（如 2 mL vs. 14 mL），幾乎必然需要換泵，這等同於必須開屏障——活動計劃即告破局。
blocks.en: Filling range limit of the RPP: The piston stroke determines the fill volume. If a campaign needs to span beyond the range a piston can cover (for example 2 mL vs. 14 mL), a pump change is almost inevitable, which amounts to having to open the barrier, and the campaign plan collapses.

blocks.zh: PP 的軟管壽命限制：蠕動泵軟管在連續運轉後因反覆擠壓而降解，可能導致微粒脫落。此使用壽命必須經過驗證，超時前必須更換或重新定位軟管。這個操作本身也需要在驗證的程序下執行。
blocks.en: Tubing life limit of the PP: Peristaltic pump tubing degrades through repeated squeezing during continuous operation, which may lead to particle shedding. This service life must be validated, and the tubing must be replaced or repositioned before it is exceeded. This operation itself must also be performed under a validated procedure.

blocks.zh: 關鍵判斷：沒有「完美」的充填技術——每種泵都有其活動模式下的侷限，設計前必須明確活動需求的完整參數範圍。
blocks.en: Key judgment: There is no "perfect" filling technology; each pump has its own limitations in campaign mode, so the full parameter range of the campaign requirements must be defined clearly before design.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 接到一個活動需求：同一客戶原料藥，需在同一生產活動中充填 2 mL（2R vial）與 14 mL（10R vial）兩種規格。
blocks.en: A CDMO receives a campaign request: drug substance from the same customer, to be filled in the same production campaign into two formats, 2 mL (2R vial) and 14 mL (10R vial).

blocks.zh: 評估：RPP 無法在密閉狀態下換泵 → 方案排除。考慮 Time-Pressure 或具備寬充填範圍的 PP（若軟管壽命在活動期間內）。同時確認傳輸系統是否支援 2R 與 10R 的通用傳輸——若採用通用撥瓶輪，需在設計時就將兩種尺寸納入設備規格。
blocks.en: Assessment: An RPP cannot change pumps in a closed state, so that option is excluded. Consider a time-pressure pump or a PP with a wide filling range (if the tubing life covers the campaign period). Also confirm whether the transport system supports universal transport of 2R and 10R; if a universal star wheel is used, both sizes must be included in the equipment specification at the design stage.

blocks.zh: 4.2 — Changeover Functionality (doc p84–p85) 4.2 — 換線功能（文件第 84–85 頁）
blocks.en: 4.2 — Changeover Functionality (doc p84–p85)

blocks.zh: OEE（Overall Equipment Effectiveness，設備整體效率）是衡量生產線投資回報的核心指標：
blocks.en: OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) is the core indicator of the return on investment of a production line:

blocks.zh:
OEE = 可用率 × 效能率 × 品質率

換型時間直接壓縮「可用率」(Availability)
→ 換型越長，OEE 越低，每 vial 成本越高
blocks.en:
OEE = Availability × Performance × Quality

Changeover time directly compresses Availability
→ the longer the changeover, the lower the OEE and the higher the cost per vial

blocks.zh: SU 技術的邊界條件：一次性使用 (Single-Use, SU) 對 PP 效益最大（完全免清洗滅菌），對 RPP 效益有限（活塞/缸體仍需清洗組裝，只有管路是 SU）。選型時不應假設「用了 SU 就解決所有問題」。
blocks.en: Boundary conditions of SU technology: Single-use (SU) offers the greatest benefit for the PP (no cleaning or sterilization at all) and limited benefit for the RPP (the piston/cylinder still has to be cleaned and assembled; only the tubing is SU). When selecting equipment, do not assume that "using SU solves every problem".

blocks.zh: 換型功能就像餐廳的翻桌效率 (Table Turnover)。高翻桌率餐廳的祕訣不是服務員跑得快，而是：桌椅設計簡單易清（少格式零件）、備品一伸手即得（人機工程）、不需要工具拆裝（Tool-less 調整）。
blocks.en: Changeover functionality is like the table turnover of a restaurant. The secret of a restaurant with high turnover is not that the waiters run faster, but that tables and chairs are simple and easy to clean (few format parts), supplies are within arm's reach (ergonomics), and no tools are needed for dismantling and fitting (tool-less adjustment).

blocks.zh: SU 技術就像改用免洗餐具 (Disposable Tableware)——PP 全套換，省去洗碗時間；但 RPP 的「鍋具」（活塞/缸體）是不鏽鋼的，免洗餐具只省了筷子和碗，鍋子還是得洗。
blocks.en: SU technology is like switching to disposable tableware: for the PP, the whole set is replaced and dishwashing time is saved; but the RPP's "cookware" (piston/cylinder) is stainless steel, so disposable tableware saves only the chopsticks and bowls, and the pots still have to be washed.

blocks.zh: 容量受限設施的危機：對於產能已達極限的 CDMO，每小時的換型停機代表的不只是「成本」，而是「失去的客戶訂單」。快速換型能力在這些設施中是直接的競爭優勢。
blocks.en: The crisis in capacity-constrained facilities: For a CDMO already at its capacity limit, every hour of changeover downtime represents not just "cost" but "lost customer orders". Rapid changeover capability is a direct competitive advantage in such facilities.

blocks.zh: 換型設計的三個槓桿點：
blocks.en: Three levers of changeover design:

blocks.zh: 減少格式零件數量（通用化設計）
blocks.en: Reduce the number of format parts (universal design)

blocks.zh: 提高格式零件涵蓋尺寸範圍（避免換型）
blocks.en: Increase the size range covered by each format part (avoid changeover)

blocks.zh: 優化人機工程與無工具操作（加快換型速度）
blocks.en: Optimize ergonomics and tool-less operation (speed up changeover)

blocks.zh: 您的充填線每批換型需要 8 小時，年換型次數 60 批。若能透過設計改善縮短至 5 小時，一年可增加多少有效產能（假設充填速度 3,000 vials/小時）？
blocks.en: Your filling line needs 8 hours per batch changeover, with 60 batch changeovers per year. If design improvements could shorten this to 5 hours, how much effective capacity would be gained in a year (assuming a filling speed of 3,000 vials/hour)?

blocks.zh: 為何對 CDMO 而言，換型速度的重要性可能高於製藥公司自有工廠？
blocks.en: Why might changeover speed matter more to a CDMO than to a pharmaceutical company's own plant?

blocks.zh: 4.3 — Functionality Affecting Line Speed (doc p85) 4.3 — 影響產線速度之功能（文件第 85 頁）
blocks.en: 4.3 — Functionality Affecting Line Speed (doc p85)

blocks.zh: 充填速度的三層決定因素：
blocks.en: Three layers of factors that determine filling speed:

blocks.zh: 第一層（影響充填技術選型）：
blocks.en: Layer 1 (affects the choice of filling technology):

blocks.zh: 循環時間 (Cycle-Time)：單一充填循環需要多少時間。充填體積大、泵循環次數多，速度就慢。
blocks.en: Cycle time: how long a single filling cycle takes. The larger the fill volume and the more pump cycles required, the slower the speed.

blocks.zh: 充填曲線 (Fill Curve)：充填過程中流速的動態輪廓——起始加速、穩定段、末端減速。產品特性（泡沫、黏度）直接影響此曲線。
blocks.en: Fill curve: the dynamic profile of flow rate during filling: initial acceleration, steady phase and final deceleration. Product properties (foaming, viscosity) directly affect this curve.

blocks.zh: 第二層（影響充填技術選型）：加減速限制——高黏度或易起泡產品必須放慢，不論機械速度多快。
blocks.en: Layer 2 (affects the choice of filling technology): Acceleration/deceleration limits: a high-viscosity or foam-prone product must be run slowly, however fast the machine can run mechanically.

blocks.zh: 第三層（不影響技術選型，但影響排程）：預充時間、班次長度、換批準備時間。這些是排程問題，不是機械問題。
blocks.en: Layer 3 (does not affect the choice of technology, but affects scheduling): Priming time, shift length and batch changeover preparation time. These are scheduling issues, not mechanical ones.

blocks.zh: IPC 模式選擇核心邏輯：
blocks.en: Core logic of IPC mode selection:

blocks.zh: 統計抽查 (Statistical IPC)：高速連續傳輸 → 適合高量、低價、允許微量過充的產品（疫苗、肝素）。
blocks.en: Statistical IPC: High-speed continuous transport, suited to high-volume, low-price products that can tolerate a slight overfill (vaccines, heparin).

blocks.zh: 100% IPC 逐個稱重：間歇傳輸（停下來稱重再走）→ 速度較低，但精度極高 → 適合高價值、小批量產品。
blocks.en: 100% IPC with individual weighing: Intermittent transport (stop, weigh, then move on); lower speed but very high accuracy, suited to high-value, small-batch products.

blocks.zh: 淨重充填 (Net-Weight Filling)：100% IPC 的升級版，不只是檢查，而是以實際稱重動態控制充填量，最大化產品保留。
blocks.en: Net-weight filling: An upgraded form of 100% IPC that does not merely check, but dynamically controls the fill amount from the actual weight, maximizing product retention.

blocks.zh: 充填速度 vs. IPC 的取捨就像超市結帳通道 (Checkout Counter) 的設計：
blocks.en: The trade-off between filling speed and IPC is like the design of supermarket checkout lanes:

blocks.zh: 統計抽查 = 快速結帳通道，不掃每件商品，只抽查幾件。速度快，偶有誤差可接受（商品便宜）。
blocks.en: Statistical IPC = the express lane: not every item is scanned, only a few are spot-checked. It is fast, and the occasional error is acceptable (the goods are cheap).

blocks.zh: 100% IPC = 標準結帳通道，每件商品都掃描確認。速度慢，但不遺漏（商品貴重）。
blocks.en: 100% IPC = the standard lane: every item is scanned and confirmed. It is slow, but nothing is missed (the goods are valuable).

blocks.zh: 淨重充填 = 高級珠寶店的精密秤量——每件都精準到小數點後三位，耗時但絕不浪費。
blocks.en: Net-weight filling = the precision weighing of a high-end jeweler: every piece is measured accurately to three decimal places, which takes time but wastes nothing.

blocks.zh: 充填曲線是不可壓縮的物理限制：無論機器多快，若產品會起泡，充填曲線的末端減速段就不能省略——否則泡沫導致充填不準，直接影響 CQA。這是產品特性決定的「硬邊界」。
blocks.en: The filling curve is an incompressible physical limit: No matter how fast the machine is, if the product foams, the final deceleration phase of the filling curve cannot be omitted, otherwise foam causes inaccurate filling and directly affects the CQA. This is a "hard boundary" set by the product's properties.

blocks.zh: 速度規格的正確設定方式：URS 中的速度應從「產量需求」反推（需要填多少單位/小時），再考量充填曲線和 IPC 模式的限制，而非直接指定一個「機械速度」數字。
blocks.en: The correct way to set a speed specification: The speed in the URS should be worked back from the "output requirement" (how many units per hour must be filled), then adjusted for the limits of the filling curve and the IPC mode, rather than specifying a "mechanical speed" figure directly.

blocks.zh: 一個高黏度生物藥，批量 5,000 vials，每 vial 售價 $5,000 USD。您會建議 100% IPC 還是統計抽查？說明理由（從 SA、CQA、商業三個層面）。
blocks.en: A high-viscosity biologic, batch size 5,000 vials, selling price $5,000 USD per vial. Would you recommend 100% IPC or statistical IPC? Explain your reasoning from three angles: SA, CQA and commercial.

blocks.zh: 為什麼巢式容器 (Nested Containers) 通常只能做統計抽查，而無法進行 100% IPC？
blocks.en: Why can nested containers usually only be checked by statistical IPC and not by 100% IPC?

blocks.zh: 4.3.2 & 4.3.3 — Product-Conserving Features and Filling Curve (doc p86) 4.3.2 & 4.3.3 — 節省產品特性與充填曲線（文件第 86 頁）
blocks.en: 4.3.2 & 4.3.3 — Product-Conserving Features and Filling Curve (doc p86)

blocks.zh: 保產功能 (Product-Conserving Features) 的八大機制：這些功能的共同邏輯是「在 Grade A 控制下修正問題，而非拒絕產品」——代表在屏障內多花幾秒鐘修正（補充填、重加塞、重壓蓋），總比丟掉一瓶每支數千美元的藥物合算。
blocks.en: The eight mechanisms of product-conserving features: The common logic of these features is to "correct problems under grade A control rather than reject the product": a few extra seconds spent correcting inside the barrier (top-up filling, re-stoppering, re-capping) is always worth more than discarding a vial of a drug worth thousands of dollars.

blocks.zh: 關鍵分類：
blocks.en: Key categories:

blocks.zh: 充填端：淨重充填（起批）、自動補充填（欠充矯正）、批末殘液最小化（稱重感應排空）
blocks.en: Filling: net-weight filling (start of batch), automatic top-up filling (correction of underfills), minimization of residual liquid at end of batch (weight-sensing drain-down)

blocks.zh: 加塞端：塞子存在性檢測 + 自動重加塞
blocks.en: Stoppering: stopper presence detection + automatic re-stoppering

blocks.zh: 壓蓋端：力矩/轉角控制 + 視覺檢測 + 自動重壓蓋
blocks.en: Capping: torque/turn-angle control + vision inspection + automatic re-capping

blocks.zh: 元件端：玻璃破損、空容器、瓶蓋品質的前端篩查
blocks.en: Components: front-end screening for glass breakage, empty containers and cap quality

blocks.zh: 保產功能的 ROI 思維 Formula
blocks.en: ROI Thinking for Product-Conserving Features

blocks.zh:
假設高價值生物藥：每 vial 售價 $3,000 USD
批量：1,000 vials

若無保產功能，損耗率假設 3% = 30 vials
損失金額 = 30 × $3,000 = $90,000/批

若有保產功能（補充填 + 重加塞），損耗率降至 0.5% = 5 vials
損失金額 = 5 × $3,000 = $15,000/批

每批節省 = $75,000
設備增購成本 vs. 10年節省的總損耗 → ROI 極高
blocks.en:
Assume a high-value biologic: selling price $3,000 USD per vial
Batch size: 1,000 vials

Without product-conserving features, assume a loss rate of 3% = 30 vials
Loss = 30 × $3,000 = $90,000 per batch

With product-conserving features (top-up filling + re-stoppering), the loss rate drops to 0.5% = 5 vials
Loss = 5 × $3,000 = $15,000 per batch

Saving per batch = $75,000
Additional equipment cost vs. total losses avoided over 10 years → very high ROI

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 充填曲線
blocks.en: Analogy — The Filling Curve

blocks.zh: 充填曲線就像咖啡師手沖咖啡時的注水手法 (Pour Pattern)——不是從頭到尾倒水速度一樣。開始時先少量浸潤（預潤濕/預排氣），中段穩定注水，快滿時必須減速避免溢出。
blocks.en: The filling curve is like the pouring technique of a barista making pour-over coffee: the water is not poured at the same speed from start to finish. At the start, a small amount wets the grounds (pre-wetting/pre-venting), the middle phase is a steady pour, and as the cup nears full the pour must slow down to avoid overflow.

blocks.zh: 「高速充填線配慢充填曲線」就像有多個咖啡師同時沖泡——每個人的手速限制是固定的（充填曲線），但可以同時開工（多針頭並行）來提升總產量。
blocks.en: "A high-speed filling line with a slow filling curve" is like having several baristas brew at once: each person's hand speed is fixed (the filling curve), but they can all work at the same time (multiple needles in parallel) to raise total output.

blocks.zh: 速度與品質的取捨框架：決策層級再次體現——
blocks.en: A framework for the speed-versus-quality trade-off: The decision hierarchy appears again:

blocks.zh: SA（無菌保證）：保產功能的所有修正步驟必須在 Grade A 控制下執行。
blocks.en: SA (sterility assurance): All correction steps of the product-conserving features must be performed under grade A control.

blocks.zh: CQA（充填量、容器密封完整性）：寧可慢一點確保每瓶達標，不可為了速度接受不合格品。
blocks.en: CQA (fill volume, container closure integrity): It is better to be slower and make sure every vial meets specification; non-conforming product must not be accepted for the sake of speed.

blocks.zh: 商業考量（速度/產量）：在前兩者滿足後，才討論如何在保產功能下優化速度。
blocks.en: Commercial considerations (speed/output): Only after the first two are satisfied should we discuss how to optimize speed with the product-conserving features in place.

blocks.zh: 充填曲線與機器速度的獨立性：生產線速度（vials/min）可以透過多針頭並行提升，但單一容器的充填時間取決於產品特性與充填曲線，無法強行縮短。
blocks.en: Independence of the filling curve from machine speed: Line speed (vials/min) can be raised by running multiple needles in parallel, but the fill time of a single container depends on the product properties and the filling curve and cannot be forcibly shortened.

blocks.zh: 一個基因治療產品，批量僅 200 vials，每 vial 成本 $50,000。您會在 URS 中要求哪些保產功能？請列出優先順序。
blocks.en: A gene therapy product, batch size only 200 vials, cost $50,000 per vial. Which product-conserving features would you require in the URS? Please list them in order of priority.

blocks.zh: 充填曲線 (Filling Curve) 和充填機速度 (Filling Machine Speed) 是什麼關係？可以同時優化兩者嗎？
blocks.en: What is the relationship between the filling curve and filling machine speed? Can both be optimized at the same time?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary (doc p81–p86)
blocks.en: Section Summary (doc p81–p86)

blocks.zh: 機器人整合：PP 因封閉系統設計最易於機器人化；RPP/TP/DP 的流體路徑設定複雜，機器人操作難度高。機器人動作設計須透過 CFD 驗證不破壞 Grade A 氣流。
blocks.en: Robotics integration: The PP is the easiest to robotize because of its closed-system design; the fluid path set-up of the RPP/TP/DP is complex and difficult for a robot to handle. Robot movement design must be verified by CFD to confirm that it does not disrupt grade A airflow.

blocks.zh: 連續/活動充填的 SA 核心：所有換型操作應在「密閉門」原則下完成；隔離器是延長生產的最強 SA 選擇；過濾器需符合 Annex 1 限制或有驗證；APS 必須涵蓋換型干預，但不能用來「決定」生產持續時間。
blocks.en: The SA core of continuous/campaign filling: All changeover operations should be completed under the "closed door" principle; the isolator is the strongest SA choice for extended production; filters must comply with the Annex 1 limit or be validated; the APS must cover changeover interventions but cannot be used to "determine" production duration.

blocks.zh: 換型功能與 OEE：換型速度影響每單位成本；SU 對 PP 最有效；通用格式零件（通用撥瓶輪、步進梁）和無工具調整是加速換型的關鍵設計策略。
blocks.en: Changeover functionality and OEE: Changeover speed affects cost per unit; SU is most effective for the PP; universal format parts (universal star wheel, walking beam) and tool-less adjustment are the key design strategies for faster changeover.

blocks.zh: 充填速度決定因素：充填曲線（產品特性決定）和 IPC 模式選擇（100% vs. 統計抽查）是影響技術選型的關鍵；保產功能在高價值產品中提供極高 ROI，但會降低表觀速度——這是正確的取捨（CQA > 速度）。
blocks.en: Determinants of filling speed: The filling curve (set by product properties) and the choice of IPC mode (100% vs. statistical) are the key factors affecting technology selection; product-conserving features provide a very high ROI for high-value products but lower the apparent speed, which is the right trade-off (CQA > speed).

blocks.zh: 決策層級貫穿全章：無菌保證 (SA) > 產品 CQA > 商業彈性——每個功能設計選擇，都應循此層級驗證其合理性。
blocks.en: The decision hierarchy runs through the whole chapter: sterility assurance (SA) > product CQA > commercial flexibility. Every functional design choice should be checked against this hierarchy for soundness.
